name: AP Calculus AB
frameworkVersion: AP Calculus AB and BC Course and Exam Description. AP Central said on 2026-10-11 that course content has not changed for 2026-27.

frq.setsNote: Whole released exams (PDF, College Board). They are not matched to units. Scoring guidelines are on the course's past-exam-questions page.

source.title: AP Calculus AB – AP Central (College Board)
source.note: Unit titles confirmed on AP Central on 2026-10-11. The page says course content has not changed for 2026-27 (only minor clarifications and new exam timing). Official topic names come from the AP Students course page, checked 2026-10-09.

units.name: Unit 1: Limits and Continuity
officialTopics: How limits help us to handle change at an instant
Definition and properties of limits in various representations
Definitions of continuity of a function at a point and over a domain
Asymptotes and limits at infinity
Reasoning using the Squeeze theorem and the Intermediate Value Theorem

units.name: Unit 2: Differentiation: Definition and Fundamental Properties
officialTopics: Defining the derivative of a function at a point and as a function
Connecting differentiability and continuity
Determining derivatives for elementary functions
Applying differentiation rules

units.name: Unit 3: Differentiation: Composite, Implicit, and Inverse Functions
officialTopics: The chain rule for differentiating composite functions
Implicit differentiation
Differentiation of general and particular inverse functions
Determining higher-order derivatives of functions

units.name: Unit 4: Contextual Applications of Differentiation
officialTopics: Identifying relevant mathematical information in verbal representations of real-world problems involving rates of change
Applying understandings of differentiation to problems involving motion
Generalizing understandings of motion problems to other situations involving rates of change
Solving related rates problems
Local linearity and approximation
L’Hospital’s rule

units.name: Unit 5: Analytical Applications of Differentiation
officialTopics: Mean Value Theorem and Extreme Value Theorem
Derivatives and properties of functions
How to use the first derivative test, second derivative test, and candidates test
Sketching graphs of functions and their derivatives
How to solve optimization problems
Behaviors of Implicit relations

units.name: Unit 6: Integration and Accumulation of Change
officialTopics: Using definite integrals to determine accumulated change over an interval
Approximating integrals using Riemann Sums
Accumulation functions, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, and definite integrals
Antiderivatives and indefinite integrals
Properties of integrals and integration techniques

units.name: Unit 7: Differential Equations
officialTopics: Interpreting verbal descriptions of change as separable differential equations
Sketching slope fields and families of solution curves
Solving separable differential equations to find general and particular solutions
Deriving and applying a model for exponential growth and decay

units.name: Unit 8: Applications of Integration
officialTopics: Determining the average value of a function using definite integrals
Modeling particle motion
Solving accumulation problems
Finding the area between curves
Determining volume with cross-sections, the disc method, and the washer method
